Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: New user signs up with email and password
Preconditions: Clerk enabled. A never-used email address you can read (e.g. qa.fresh1@yourdomain).
Steps:
1. Open /sign-up
2. Enter the email and a strong password, submit
3. Enter the email verification code from the inbox
4. Observe where the browser lands
Expected result: Clerk sign-up completes and the browser lands on /create-organization (the page shows a company-name form plus an organisation switcher). No error toast. No company exists in the Admin console yet for this user.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Creating the organisation creates the company and logs the user in as company admin
Steps:
1. Type the company name "QA Fresh Haulage" and submit
2. Wait for redirect
3. Open the user card at the bottom of the sidebar
Expected result: Browser lands on /del-dashboard. Dashboard loads once (no request loop in the Network tab). Role shown is "Deliverer Admin". Platform admin sees the new company in Admin console with state "On trial" and plan band "1-2 trucks". daysLeft is 30 (trial ends 30 days after creation).

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Second sign-in on the same browser keeps the user signed in
Steps:
1. Close the tab, reopen the app URL
2. Observe
Expected result: User is still signed in and lands on /del-dashboard (or / which redirects to /del-dashboard). No flash of /login longer than the loading state.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Existing user logs in
Preconditions: ALPHA-ADMIN exists and is signed out.
Steps:
1. Open /login
2. Enter email and password
3. Submit
Expected result: Lands on /del-dashboard showing Alpha data. Sidebar shows Alpha's name and the role "Deliverer Admin".

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Wrong password is rejected
Steps:
1. Open /login
2. Enter the right email and a wrong password
3. Submit
Expected result: Clerk shows an inline "password is incorrect" style error. User stays on /login. No app data is loaded.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Deep link while signed out goes to login
Steps:
1. Paste https://<env>/del-vehicles in the address bar
2. Observe
3. Repeat for /del-invoices, /add-job, /del-admin-console
Expected result: Each path ends on /login. No page content (not even a skeleton with data) is shown before the redirect.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Sign out
Steps:
1. Open the user menu in the top bar and choose Log Out (Clerk sign-out)
2. After redirect press the browser Back button
3. Reload /del-dashboard
Expected result: Redirected to /login after sign-out. Back button and reload do not show Alpha data; they end on /login.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Signed-in user with no organisation is sent to create or choose one
Preconditions: A Clerk account that has no organisation membership (do not use a platform admin).
Steps:
1. Sign in
2. Observe
Expected result: Browser goes to /create-organization. Redux error text "Choose or create a company" may flash; the app does not show company pages. Choosing an organisation in the switcher then loads the dashboard.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Switching organisation shows only the other company's data
Preconditions: A Clerk user who is a member of both QA Alpha and QA Bravo (see TEST_DATA).
Steps:
1. Sign in with Alpha active and open /del-customers, note the names
2. Go to /create-organization and use the organisation switcher to select Bravo
3. Open /del-customers, /del-vehicles, /del-all-orders
4. Switch back to Alpha
Expected result: After the switch the lists show ONLY Bravo records; no Alpha customer, vehicle or job appears even briefly after a hard refresh. Switching back shows only Alpha records. API calls never return the other company's rows.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Clerk org role maps to app role
Preconditions: One org admin and one plain member in QA Alpha.
Steps:
1. Sign in as the org admin, read the role in the sidebar
2. Sign in as the member, read the role
Expected result: Org admin = "Deliverer Admin"; member = "Deliverer Manager". The role is re-synced at every bootstrap (change the member to admin in Clerk, sign out/in: role becomes Deliverer Admin).

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Invited member joins the right company
Preconditions: ALPHA-ADMIN can invite via the Clerk organisation UI. A new email.
Steps:
1. Invite the email to QA Alpha as member
2. Accept the invite and sign up
3. Land in the app
4. As ALPHA-ADMIN open Management > Admins
Expected result: New user lands on QA Alpha's dashboard as "Deliverer Manager" and appears in the Admins list. They are not in any other company. NOTE the plan user allowance is NOT checked on this path (see README ambiguity list): record how many users the company now has.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Verified email links an existing legacy account instead of duplicating it
Preconditions: A legacy user (created before Clerk, role Deliverer Admin, company set) whose email you control and who has no clerkUserId. Staging only.
Steps:
1. Sign up in Clerk with that exact email and verify it
2. Create/choose an organisation
3. Check the dashboard
4. Count users with that email in the DB or Admins list
Expected result: The Clerk identity is linked to the existing user (no second user row for that email). Existing data is visible. An UNVERIFIED email must never link.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Expired Clerk session returns to login without a loop
Steps:
1. In Clerk dashboard revoke the session (or wait for expiry)
2. Click any sidebar item
3. Watch the Network tab
Expected result: API returns 401 "Session expired, please login again" (or NEEDS_BOOTSTRAP flow). UI ends on /login or the "We couldn't finish setting up your account" screen with Try again and Sign out buttons. No endless request loop (max a handful of requests).

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: "We couldn't finish setting up your account" screen
Preconditions: Signed in with Clerk, but make /auth/bootstrap fail (e.g. block it in DevTools).
Steps:
1. Reload the app
2. Read the screen
3. Click Try again, then Sign out
Expected result: Screen shows the heading, the error text and "Your data is safe". Try again reloads. Sign out goes to /login. No redirect ping-pong between /login and /del-dashboard.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Forgot password through Clerk
Steps:
1. On /login choose the forgot-password link
2. Complete the emailed code flow and set a new password
3. Log in with the new password
Expected result: Password changes; old password no longer works.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: valid email and password login sets a cookie
Preconditions: Legacy mode. A user with a password.
Steps:
1. POST /api/v2/user/login-user with {email, password} (or use the legacy /login page)
2. Inspect the response headers
Expected result: HTTP 201, JSON has success true. Cookie "token" is set HttpOnly, SameSite=None, Secure. Cookie lifetime is 1 day. NOTE the JSON body currently also contains the user and the token string (see README ambiguity list).

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: wrong email and wrong password give the same message
Steps:
1. POST login-user with an unknown email
2. POST login-user with a known email and wrong password
Expected result: Both return HTTP 400 with message "Invalid email or password" (cannot tell which part was wrong). Response never includes a password hash.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: login validation
Steps:
1. POST login-user with an empty body
2. POST with email as an object {"$ne":null} and any password
Expected result: First returns 400 "Enter all the fields". Second returns 400 (operator keys are stripped; typeof check fails). No successful login.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: login is rate limited
Preconditions: Legacy mode, staging (limits are off only in the automated test environment).
Steps:
1. Send 21 POSTs to /api/v2/user/login-user within 15 minutes from one IP
2. Observe the 21st
Expected result: The 21st call returns HTTP 429 with message "Too many requests, please try again shortly." The same limiter covers create-user, activation, forgot-password and reset-password. Normal use afterwards works once the 15-minute window passes.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: forgot password does not reveal whether an email exists
Preconditions: Legacy mode, SMTP configured (or RESET_PASSWORD_DEV_LINK=true on staging).
Steps:
1. POST forgot-password for a real email
2. POST forgot-password for an email that does not exist
Expected result: Both return 200 with "If an account exists for that email, you will receive a password reset link shortly." Only the real one gets a mail with a link valid for 15 minutes. Empty email returns 400 "Please provide your email".

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: reset password rules
Steps:
1. Open /reset-password?token=... and set a 7-character password
2. Set an 8-character password
3. Reuse the same link
4. Use a link older than 15 minutes
Expected result: 7 chars rejected "Password must be at least 8 characters". 8 chars accepted "Password updated. You can sign in with your new password." Reusing the link and an expired link both return 400 "Invalid or expired reset token".

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: public create-user sends an activation mail and ignores role/company
Steps:
1. POST create-user with name, email, phoneNumber, address, city, password (8+ chars) AND extra fields role "Super Admin" and a real companyId
2. Click the activation link
3. Call GET /api/v2/user/get-user
Expected result: create-user returns 201 "Check your email to finish verification". After activation the user exists with NO company and a normal role (the extra fields are ignored). get-user answers 400 "Error , Deliverer not found". Existing email returns 400 "User exists". Password under 8 chars returns 400.

Module name: Sign-up and login (Clerk, plus legacy cookie login)
Title: Legacy: activation link expires after 5 minutes
Steps: 1. Wait 6 minutes, open /activation/<token>
Expected result: Activation fails with an error toast/message; no user created.

Title: Brand-new company dashboard shows zeros, not errors
Steps:
1. Open /del-dashboard
2. Open DevTools Console and Network
3. Read the tiles
Expected result: Tiles Total Jobs, Tot Revenue, Customers, Contractors show 0. Charts show empty state. No red console errors; no HTTP 4xx/5xx on overallStats calls (an empty year returns a zero object, not an error).

Title: Getting started checklist content
Steps: 1. Read the "Get started: N of 5 done" panel
Expected result: Five steps in order: Add your first truck (Plate number, make and size.), Add a driver (Name, ID number and licence.), Add a customer (Who you haul for.), Record your first job (Or import past jobs from Excel on the Jobs page.), Send your first invoice (Turn a finished job into an invoice.). Header reads "Get started: 0 of 5 done".

Title: Checklist steps link to the right pages
Steps: 1. Click each step in turn
Expected result: Routes: /del-vehicles, /del-drivers, /del-customers, /add-job, /del-invoices.

Title: Checklist ticks off as records are added
Steps:
1. Add one vehicle, return to /del-dashboard
2. Add a driver, a customer, a job
3. Re-check the panel each time
Expected result: Counter increments 1, 2, 3, 4 of 5 and the completed step is struck through with a tick. Counts come from GET /tenant/setup (vehicles, drivers, customers, jobs, invoices).

Title: Invoice step on a company where Invoices is off
Preconditions: FRESH company (Invoices module off by default).
Steps: 1. Click "Send your first invoice"
Expected result: Record what happens. Expected by design: either the step is hidden or /del-invoices shows "This feature is switched off" with a Go to Modules link. Raise a UX defect if the step is a dead end with no explanation.

Title: New company default modules
Steps: 1. Open Settings > Modules
Expected result: Only "Revenue analytics" is ON. Expenses & profitability, Fuel log, Tractor units, Cross-border trips, Quotations, Invoices & payments, Maintenance & tyres and AI logbook import are OFF. No module shows "Coming soon" (all are available).

Title: Sidebar matches the enabled modules
Steps:
1. Read the sidebar
2. Switch on Expenses, Fuel, Invoices, Trips, Maintenance in Modules
3. Re-read the sidebar
Expected result: Initially: Dashboard, Order Central (Overview, View All, Customers, Contractors), Revenue ($ Overview, Daily, Monthly, Breakdown), Management (Admins, Vehicles, Drivers), Settings (Modules). After enabling: Profitability, Expenses, Fuel Log, Billing > Quotations/Invoices, Trucking > Trips/Trailers/Documents, Maintenance appear. Disabled items never show.

Title: Empty list pages show a helpful empty state
Steps: 1. Open /del-customers, /del-contractors, /del-all-orders, /del-vehicles, /del-drivers
Expected result: Each shows an empty state (e.g. "No contractors to show ... Add the companies you work with using the Add button.") and the Add button works. No spinner stuck forever, no crash.

Title: Add Job with nothing set up does not crash
Preconditions: FRESH company with no contractor, vehicle or driver.
Steps:
1. Open /add-job
2. Try to move through Order Details > Company Info > Preview
Expected result: Page renders. Dropdowns are empty; Add Job cannot be completed; no uncaught exception in the console and no white screen.

Title: Trial banner is quiet on day 1
Steps: 1. Look under the top bar on any page
Expected result: No billing banner is shown (it only appears when 7 or fewer days remain, or the company is read-only).

Title: First truck is added without a plan problem
Steps: 1. Add truck 1 and truck 2 (Make, Size, Reg Number)
Expected result: Both succeed. Admin console still shows band "1-2 trucks".

Title: Platform admin with no company
Preconditions: PLATFORM user (role Super Admin, no companyId).
Steps:
1. Sign in
2. Observe landing page
3. Open /del-dashboard directly
Expected result: In Clerk mode the redirect target is /del-dashboard (legacy login goes to /del-admin-console). Record where the user lands. The dashboard must not crash; the sidebar shows "Admin console". Product owner should confirm intended landing page (see ambiguity list).

Title: Manager cannot read finance data through the API
Preconditions: ALPHA-MGR signed in, Invoices/Expenses/Fuel modules ON.
Steps:
1. GET /api/v2/expense/get-expenses
2. GET /api/v2/fuel/get-fills
3. GET /api/v2/invoice/get-invoices
4. GET /api/v2/quotation/get-quotations
5. GET /api/v2/payment/get-payments
Expected result: Every call returns 403 "Only company admins can manage this data". No data in the body.

Title: Manager cannot write finance data
Steps:
1. POST /api/v2/expense/create-expense with a valid body
2. POST /api/v2/invoice/create-invoice
3. POST /api/v2/fuel/create-fill
Expected result: All return 403. Nothing is created (check as ALPHA-ADMIN).

Title: Manager sidebar vs access
Steps:
1. Open the sidebar
2. Click Expenses, Fuel Log, Invoices, Quotations
Expected result: Record whether the finance links are visible. They are currently shown (menu hides only by module). Clicking them must show an error toast/empty page and never the data. Raise a UX defect if the page appears broken without explanation.

Title: Manager cannot change modules, export data, delete the company or add admins
Expected result: All four return 403 ("You are not authorized to do this" / "You are not authorized to add admins"). Modules unchanged, no deletion scheduled.

Title: Manager can do day-to-day operations
Steps:
1. Create a customer, a vehicle, a driver (with both images), a contractor with rates, a job
2. Edit and delete the customer you created
Expected result: All succeed (core records have no role gate beyond sign-in and company ownership). This is by design: record the result so the owner can confirm.

Title: Manager can use operational modules without finance role
Preconditions: ALPHA-MGR, Cross-border, Tractor units, Maintenance and AI import modules ON.
Steps:
1. Create a trip, trailer, compliance document, maintenance record
2. Open Import from photo
Expected result: These succeed (trips, trailers, documents, maintenance and AI import only require a company and the module). Trip prices and cost lines are therefore visible to managers: owner to confirm intended.

Title: Company admin can change modules
Steps: 1. Settings > Modules, toggle Fuel log off, then on
Expected result: Switch changes persist after reload; Fuel Log leaves/returns in the sidebar within about 30 seconds on the API side. Unknown module keys or non-boolean values via the API return 400 ("Unknown module: x" / "x must be true or false").

Title: Company admin cannot grant platform roles
Steps:
1. POST create-admin with role "Super Admin"
2. PUT update-admin changing a user's role to "Site Admin"
Expected result: Both return 403 "You are not authorized to assign this role". Role list in the Add Admin form for a company admin should still be checked: record whether platform roles are offered in the dropdown.

Title: Company admin cannot edit or delete a user of another company
Preconditions: ALPHA-ADMIN and a BRAVO user id.
Steps:
1. PUT update-admin with adminId = Bravo user
2. DELETE delete-admin/<Bravo user id>
Expected result: Both return 404 ("User not found" / "There is no admin with this id") exactly like a non-existent id. Bravo user unchanged.

Title: Cannot delete own account
Steps: 1. DELETE delete-admin/<own id>
Expected result: 400 "You can't delete your own account".

Title: Company admin cannot touch a platform admin account
Preconditions: ALPHA-ADMIN and the PLATFORM user id.
Steps:
1. PUT update-admin on the platform user
2. DELETE delete-admin on the platform user
Expected result: 404 for both (platform accounts look non-existent).

Title: Platform-only endpoints refuse company users
Steps:
1. GET /api/v2/admin/companies
2. GET /api/v2/admin/summary
3. PUT /api/v2/tenant/billing
4. POST /api/v2/deliverer/create-deliverer
Expected result: All return 403 "You are not authorized to do this".

Title: Site Admin vs finance data
Preconditions: SITE user (role Site Admin) acting with a company. Staging.
Steps:
1. GET /api/v2/expense/get-expenses
2. GET /api/v2/tenant/export?companyId=<Alpha>
Expected result: Expenses returns 403 (Site Admin is not in the finance roles). Export succeeds (Site and Super Admin may export any company). Record any surprise.

Title: Admin console menu hidden from company users
Steps:
1. Look for "Admin console" in the sidebar
2. Open /del-admin-console directly
Expected result: Menu item absent. The page shows "This page is for platform admins." and the API stays 403.

Title: Admins page is reachable only when signed in
Steps:
1. Open /del-admins and /del-deliverers directly
2. Call GET /api/v2/user/get-all-admins-page
Expected result: These two routes are not wrapped in the protected-route component. Page may render an empty shell; the API must answer 401 "Login to continue!" and show no data. Raise a defect if any admin or company name is visible.

Title: Admin list paging
Preconditions: ALPHA-ADMIN, company with 30+ users (use the seed).
Steps:
1. Open Admins
2. Go to the next page
3. Search a name
Expected result: Page 1 shows 25 rows, page 2 shows the rest, search filters name/city/address/role. Record any duplicate or missing row at the page boundary (page arithmetic uses query strings).

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: New company billing record
Steps:
1. As ALPHA-ADMIN-equivalent for FRESH, GET /api/v2/tenant/me
2. Read the billing object
Expected result: billing.state "trial", band "starter", bandLabel "1-2 trucks", priceUsd 9, writable true, readOnlyReason null, daysLeft 30 (29 or 30 depending on time of day), limits {trucks 2, users 3, aiPagesPerMonth 50}. The response contains no "note" field.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Band definitions are correct
Steps:
1. PUT billing {band:"fleet"} then GET tenant/me
2. PUT {band:"pro"} then GET
3. PUT {band:"starter"} then GET
Expected result: fleet: label "3-10 trucks", price 29, trucks 10, users 10, AI 200. pro: "11-25 trucks", 59, 25, 25, 500. starter: "1-2 trucks", 9, 2, 3, 50.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Trial banner shows when 7 or fewer days remain
Steps:
1. PUT billing {trialEndsAt: now + 5 days}
2. Reload any page as that company's admin (allow 30 s for the server cache)
Expected result: Banner under the top bar reads: "Your free trial ends in 5 days. You will not be charged automatically; we send an invoice and you decide." Boundary texts: 1 day left shows "in 1 day"; trial ending later today shows "today". At 8 days left no banner.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Trial boundary: still writable at the end, read-only just after
Steps:
1. PUT {trialEndsAt: now + 2 minutes}, add a customer (succeeds)
2. Wait until 3 minutes have passed (plus the 30 s cache)
3. Try to add a customer again
Expected result: First write succeeds. After the end the write returns HTTP 402 code READ_ONLY with "Your free trial has ended. Your data is safe and you can still view and download it. Contact us to continue." Banner now reads "Your free trial has ended, so changes are paused. Your data is safe and you can still view and download it. Message us to continue."

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Mark paid +30 days (Admin console)
Steps:
1. Admin console > Manage > Mark paid, +30 days
2. Wait up to 30 s
3. As that company's admin add a customer
Expected result: Toast "Paid until <date>". Status becomes active, paidUntil = now + 30 days. The company can write again and the banner disappears. History lists "billing.update" by the platform admin email.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Mark paid twice stacks from the existing paid-until date
Preconditions: Company active with paidUntil in the future (e.g. +20 days).
Steps: 1. Click Mark paid, +30 days
Expected result: New paidUntil = old paidUntil + 30 days (about +50 days from now), not now + 30.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Payment grace period
Steps:
1. PUT {status:"active", paidUntil: now - 3 days}, try a write
2. PUT {paidUntil: now - 8 days}, try a write
Expected result: At 3 days past due: write succeeds (grace is 7 days), state still "active", daysLeft negative. At 8 days past due: write returns 402 READ_ONLY "Your subscription payment is overdue. Your data is safe and you can still view and download it. Contact us to continue." Banner: "Your subscription payment is overdue, so changes are paused. You can still view and download everything."

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Suspended and cancelled statuses
Steps:
1. PUT {status:"suspended"} then try a write and read the banner
2. PUT {status:"cancelled"} and repeat
Expected result: Suspended: write returns HTTP 403 "This account is suspended. Contact us to restore it. You can still download your data." Banner "This account is suspended. You can still download your data. Message us to restore it." Cancelled: HTTP 402 "This account has been cancelled. You can still view and download your data." Reading and exporting still work in both.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Server caches billing state for about 30 seconds
Expected result: Block takes effect within about 30 seconds (cache), never later. Same on restore. Record the observed delay.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Trial-ending email
Preconditions: Company in trial with an admin user whose inbox you can read. SMTP configured.
Expected result: One email to each Deliverer Admin. Subject "Your myFleet trial ends in 6 days" (1 day: "in 1 day"). Body names the company, the plan "1-2 trucks (USD 9 a month)", says the account becomes read-only after the trial, and says "Pay by EcoCash to +263 778 115 084 and put "<company name>" as the reference, or reply to this email for bank transfer details." Response results contains {kind:"trial_ending", sent:1}.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Trial-ended email
Preconditions: Company whose trial ended 2 days ago.
Steps:
1. Run billing-notices
2. Read the mail
Expected result: Subject "Your myFleet trial has ended". Body says the account is now read-only, "Your data is safe, and you can always view it and download a full copy.", and quotes the plan and EcoCash line.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Payment-due email window
Steps:
1. PUT paidUntil = now + 4 days, run notices
2. PUT paidUntil = now + 2.5 days, run notices
3. Run notices again without changing anything
4. PUT paidUntil = now + 0.5 day (a new date), run notices
Expected result: No mail at 4 days left. At 2.5 days left (rounded up to 3) a mail "Your myFleet subscription is due in 3 days" is sent. The repeat run sends nothing. The new date sends a fresh mail "Your myFleet subscription is due in 1 day" (singular "1 day").

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Payment-overdue email
Steps: 1. Run billing-notices
Expected result: Subject "Your myFleet payment is overdue", body says account is read-only and "Once payment is received it opens straight away."

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: No email during the 7-day grace window
Steps: 1. Run billing-notices
Expected result: No payment_due mail (days left is negative) and no overdue mail (not read-only yet). Record this gap: the owner hears nothing between the due date and day 8 (see README ambiguity list).

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Each notice is sent once per date
Preconditions: Company in trial ending in 5 days.
Steps:
1. Run billing-notices twice
2. Check inbox
3. PUT {extendTrialDays: 2} and run again
Expected result: First run sends one mail, second run sends none (results empty for this company). After the trial date changes, the next run sends a fresh trial_ending mail.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Only company admins receive reminders
Preconditions: Company with one Deliverer Admin and one Deliverer Manager.
Steps: 1. Run billing-notices for an ending trial
Expected result: Mail goes to the admin only. A company with no Deliverer Admin user gets nothing and the notice is not marked sent.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Legacy, suspended and cancelled companies get no reminders
Preconditions: QA State Legacy, Suspended and Cancelled companies.
Steps: 1. Run billing-notices
Expected result: results contain no entry for them; no mail received.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Cron endpoint security
Steps:
1. GET /api/v2/tenant/billing-notices with no header
2. with a wrong bearer value
3. with the correct bearer
4. Repeat for /api/v2/tenant/purge-due
Expected result: No header and wrong header: 401 "Not authorized". Correct: 200 {success:true, results:[...]}. If CRON_SECRET is not set at all the route answers 404 "Not available". A browser session cookie does not authorise the cron route.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Email failure is retried, not lost
Preconditions: SMTP deliberately broken on staging (wrong password).
Steps:
1. Run billing-notices for an ending trial
2. Fix SMTP
3. Run again
Expected result: First run returns an entry with "error" and does NOT mark the notice sent. Second run delivers it.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: PUT billing input validation
Steps:
1. PUT with no companyId
2. band "gold"
3. status "paused"
4. trialEndsAt "not a date"
5. extendTrialDays 400
6. unknown but valid companyId
Expected result: 400 "Say which company (companyId)"; 400 "band must be one of starter, fleet, pro"; 400 "status must be trial, active, suspended or cancelled"; 400 "trialEndsAt is not a date"; 400 "extendTrialDays must be between -365 and 365"; 404 "Company not found". No change is saved on any failure.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: extendTrialDays semantics
Preconditions: Company in trial with 10 days left, and another with an expired trial.
Steps: 1. PUT {extendTrialDays: 14} on each
Expected result: In-trial company: trialEndsAt = old end + 14 days. Expired company: trialEndsAt = NOW + 14 days (it does not add to the old past date) and it becomes writable again.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Note field is capped and private
Expected result: Stored note is the first 500 characters. Company users never see the note.

Module name: Trial, plans, billing and reminder emails
Title: Every billing change is audited
Steps:

Title: Multiple tabs
Steps:
1. Add a vehicle in tab 1
2. Open the Add Job page in tab 2 without reloading
Expected result: Tab 2 does not list the new vehicle until reload. No error, no corruption.

Module name: Notifications, toasts, emails and real-time behaviour
Title: Session expiry mid-work
Steps: 1. Revoke the session, then submit
Expected result: Clear "Session expired, please login again" (or sign-in redirect); user is not shown a success toast; after logging back in the data is not duplicated.

Title: Whitespace-only and empty required fields
Preconditions: Customer, vehicle, driver, contractor, trip, invoice, expense, fill-up forms.
Steps:
1. Fill required fields with spaces only
2. Submit
Expected result: Treated as empty: refused with the field's required message. Nothing saved.

Title: Very long text
Steps: 1. Paste 5,000 and 100,000 characters into Name, Address, Description, Notes
Expected result: Either truncated by documented limits (trip fields 80 to 1000, invoice notes 2000) or refused; no crash, no 500, UI stays usable, lists do not break their layout.

Title: Unicode, emoji, apostrophes, quotes
Steps: 1. Names: "Ñandú Éxpress 🚚", "O'Neil & Sons", "Quote \"Q\" Ltd", Chinese and Arabic text
Expected result: Saved and displayed identically in lists, dialogs, CSV, PDF (PDF may substitute unsupported glyphs: record) and exports. Search finds them.

Title: Double-click on save
Preconditions: Add customer, Add vehicle, Issue invoice, Record payment, Add Job.
Steps: 1. Double-click (or click twice fast) the save button
Expected result: Exactly one record is created. Issue and payment actions never apply twice (second click returns an error or is ignored). Check lists and numbering afterwards.

Title: Browser back and refresh in the Add Job wizard
Preconditions: Add Job at the Preview step.
Steps:
1. Press Back
2. Refresh
3. Use Reset
Expected result: No half-saved job. Reset clears all fields. Refresh returns to an empty wizard without errors.

Title: Invalid ids in URLs
Steps:
1. Browse /del-dash-vehicle/abc, /vehicle-analytics/123, /driver-analytics/zzz, /job-analytics/xyz
2. Call DELETE /vehicle/delete-vehicle/abc and GET /fuel/... with bad ids
Expected result: Pages show an error/empty state, no white screen. API answers 400/404 ("Invalid id", "Not found"), never 500.

Title: Unknown routes
Steps: 1. Open /nothing-here, /del-unknown, /api/v2/unknown
Expected result: Frontend: record what shows (the router has no catch-all page; a blank page is a UX defect). API: JSON 404/SPA fallback, no stack.

Title: Year and paging parameters
Steps:
1. GET /overallStats/get-all-overallStats-company?year=1999
2. ?year=abc
3. ?year=3000
4. /job/get-all-jobs-page?page=-1
5. ?limit=100000
6. ?sort=notjson
Expected result: Year outside 2000-2100 or non-integer: 400 "Invalid year query parameter". Negative/huge page and limit are clamped or refused. A bad sort value does not return 500 text containing internals.

Title: Numeric extremes
Preconditions: Job cost, distance, expense amount, fuel litres.
Expected result: Invalid values refused; valid ones saved with two-decimal rounding; no NaN or Infinity anywhere (lists, dashboard, CSV). Record how a comma decimal is treated.

Title: Date extremes
Preconditions: Trip, job, expense, fill, document dates.
Expected result: Invalid calendar dates refused. Extreme but valid dates handled without breaking charts (record any chart that stretches to 1900). Timezone does not shift the saved day.

Title: Duplicate-detection edge cases
Preconditions: Customer, vehicle, driver, trailer, tyre, trip reference.
Steps: 1. Create duplicates differing only by case and spacing ("qaa 1001" vs "QAA1001"; "ZZA 1234" vs "zza1234"; tyre " t-001 ")
Expected result: Plates and serials treated as the same (trailer, tyre, vehicle form removes spaces and upper-cases). Customer names: exact trimmed match is a duplicate; record whether different case creates a second record.

Title: Delete something that is in use
Preconditions: Contractor with jobs, customer on jobs, vehicle on trips, driver on fills, trailer on trips, tyre fitted.
Steps: 1. Delete each
Expected result: Trailer and fitted tyre refuse with explanations. Others are deleted without a block: record the effect on dependent pages (see VEH-010, DRV-007, CUS-005, CTR-006). Raise defects for crashes.

Title: Offline and flaky network
Preconditions: Any list page and a form.
Steps:
1. Go offline, click around, submit
2. Go online
3. Throttle to Slow 3G and repeat the Add Job
Expected result: Offline: error toast, no endless spinner, no data loss in open forms. Slow 3G: save completes; double submission cannot happen.

Title: Large payloads
Preconditions: Job create with 50 legs; import of 300 rows; invoice with 1,000 lines (limit) and 1,001 lines.
Steps: 1. Submit each
Expected result: Within limits: succeeds. 1,001 invoice lines: "Too many lines". Payloads over 2 MB: refused (413).

Title: Browser autofill and password managers
Steps: 1. Let the browser autofill
Expected result: Autofill does not put the admin's own email or password into unrelated fields (e.g. customer name); form still validates correctly.

Title: Clock skew
Steps: 1. Create a trip, a fill and a document
Expected result: Server-side validations (not the device clock) decide statuses; record any UI that uses the device date (e.g. document status is calculated on the server at read time).

Title: Chrome latest on Windows 11
Steps: 1. Run the core script
Expected result: All nine steps pass; no console errors.

Title: Chrome latest on Android phone (mid-range, e.g. 360x800)
Steps: 1. Run the core script
Expected result: All steps pass; sidebar opens as a drawer and closes after navigation; forms usable with the on-screen keyboard; camera capture works for driver documents.

Title: Safari on iPhone (iOS 16+)
Steps: 1. Run the core script
Expected result: All steps pass. Cookie/session persists after backgrounding the app. HEIC photos for drivers are converted or handled (driver upload) and AI photo requires JPG per the message.

Title: Safari latest on macOS
Steps: 1. Run the core script
Expected result: All steps pass; third-party cookie settings do not break Clerk sign-in; PDF opens in the viewer.

Title: Firefox latest on Windows or Linux
Steps: 1. Run the core script
Expected result: All steps pass; downloads (CSV/ZIP/PDF) work.

Title: Edge latest
Steps: 1. Run the core script
Expected result: All steps pass.

Title: Chrome on a low-end Android (2 GB RAM)
Preconditions: Throttled CPU 4x in DevTools if no device.
Steps: 1. Dashboard and All Orders with 1,000+ jobs
Expected result: Pages remain usable (no tab crash); first load completes within about 10 s on 4G.

Title: Samsung Internet and Opera Mini/Mobile
Steps: 1. Sign in and view dashboard
Expected result: Record support level (Opera Mini is not expected to work). Clerk sign-in must at least show a clear message if unsupported.

Title: Layout widths
Steps: 1. Check 360x640, 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1366x768, 1920x1080 on dashboard, All Orders, Add Job, Drivers dialog, Invoices
Expected result: No horizontal scroll of the whole page; grids scroll inside their container; dialogs fit the screen and scroll; buttons reachable; charts resize; no overlapping text.

Title: Zoom and text size
Steps: 1. Zoom to 150% and 200%; set browser minimum font size large
Expected result: Content reflows; nothing important is cut off; sidebar still usable.

Title: Dark and light theme
Preconditions: Theme toggle in the top bar.
Steps: 1. Toggle the theme on dashboard, forms, dialogs, grids, charts and the billing banner
Expected result: Text remains readable in both; the choice persists on reload (record) and is applied to dialogs and tooltips.

Title: Orientation change
Steps: 1. Rotate during Add Job and in the invoice form
Expected result: Layout adapts, entered data kept.

Title: Print
Steps: 1. Print the dashboard and an invoice view
Expected result: Print layout acceptable (print-content areas).

Title: Time zones and locales
Preconditions: Set the OS time zone to UTC+2 (Harare), UTC-5 and UTC+13; locale en-ZW and en-US.
Steps: 1. Add a job and a trip dated near midnight; read dates in lists, CSV and PDF
Expected result: Calendar date is the same everywhere for the same record; numbers keep two decimals; no US/UK day-month swap in displayed dates.

Title: Keyboard-only navigation
Steps: 1. Tab through the top bar, sidebar, a list page, a dialog (Add Customer), a wizard
Expected result: Every control is reachable in a logical order, has a visible focus ring and can be activated with Enter/Space. Escape closes dialogs. No keyboard trap.

Title: Dialog focus handling
Steps:
1. Open
2. Tab repeatedly
3. Close with Escape
Expected result: Focus moves into the dialog, stays inside while open and returns to the button that opened it afterwards.

Title: Form labels and errors
Steps:
1. Inspect each input with the accessibility inspector
2. Submit invalid
Expected result: Every input has an accessible name (label text or aria-label). Errors are shown as text near the field and announced (toast has status role). Required fields indicated.

Title: Icon buttons are named
Steps: 1. Inspect Edit, Delete, View icon buttons, the Modules switches and the sidebar toggle
Expected result: Each has an accessible name (e.g. aria-label "Edit", "Delete", "View", module label on the switch). Report unnamed buttons.

Title: Colour contrast
Steps: 1. Check body text, secondary text (reduced opacity), buttons, chips, banner, chart labels
Expected result: Contrast at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text and icons. Secondary text with 0.6-0.7 opacity is the likely failure: list every failing element.

Title: Meaning not by colour alone
Preconditions: Fuel check (OK/Check/Review), document status, invoice overdue, quotation status.
Steps: 1. Review with a grayscale filter
Expected result: Each status also has a text label, not only a colour.

Title: Charts have text alternatives
Steps: 1. Use a screen reader on the charts
Expected result: Provide or record whether a table/summary alternative exists (the totals tiles repeat key numbers). Raise as an enhancement if none.

Title: Page title and language
Steps: 1. Check document title and the html lang attribute
Expected result: Title identifies the product and ideally the page; lang="en". Record if every page has the same title.

Title: Zoom/reflow and target size
Steps: 1. 200% zoom and touch the smallest controls
Expected result: Controls are at least about 24 px (ideally 44 px) and not overlapping.

Title: Reduced motion
Steps: 1. Open the app
Expected result: No essential animation; transitions are not distracting.

Title: Dashboard makes a sensible number of requests
Steps: 1. Open Network, clear, load /del-dashboard and wait 30 seconds
Expected result: A few dozen requests at most and then silence. No repeating calls (the earlier loop made about 5,900 calls in 6 seconds). Fail if any endpoint repeats every few hundred milliseconds. Repeat on the five analytics pages.

Title: Dashboard load time
Steps: 1. Reload /del-dashboard
Expected result: Usable within about 3 seconds; charts drawn within 5 seconds. Record the figure; investigate above 8 seconds.

Title: Lists with large data are paged
Steps: 1. Open All Orders and Customers, sort and search
Expected result: Only one page of rows is fetched at a time; sort and search return within about 2 seconds; the browser stays responsive.

Title: First load and bundle
Steps: 1. Lighthouse (mobile, Fast 4G) on /login and /del-dashboard
Expected result: Record Performance score and transfer size; pages are lazy-loaded so the first bundle is smaller than the whole app. Investigate a score below 50.

Title: Cold start
Preconditions: Production after at least 15 minutes idle.
Steps: 1. Load the dashboard first thing
Expected result: First API call may be slower (serverless start) but completes well under the 30-second function limit; no timeout page.

Title: Heavy endpoints stay under the 30 s function limit
Steps: 1. Time the company export, Excel commit of 300 rows, jobs PDF for All Years, rebuild-stats
Expected result: Each completes in under 30 seconds. Record durations; a 504/timeout is a defect.

Title: Memory and long sessions
Steps: 1. Keep the dashboard open 30 minutes with idle timer, then navigate 20 pages
Expected result: No steady growth beyond a few hundred MB, no polling requests, no console errors.

Title: Image upload speed
Steps: 1. Upload two 12 MP photos
Expected result: Client shrinking keeps uploads to a few seconds; progress/disabled button prevents repeated clicks.

Title: Search responsiveness
Steps: 1. Type quickly into the search box
Expected result: No request storm (debounced) and no lost keystrokes; final results match the final text.
